description: This file contains unit tests for the ConsulClusteringOptions class, verifying default behaviors, exception handling, client injection, and configuration setup using the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: ConsulClusteringOptionsTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the ConsulClusteringOptions class.

classes.name: FakeConsul
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IConsulClient interface used for testing client injection.

methods.name: DefaultCreationBehaviorIsRetained
methods.description: Verifies that the default creation behavior of ConsulClusteringOptions retains a non-null client.

methods.name: ThrowsArgumentNullExceptionIfCallbackIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that configuring the Consul client with a null callback throws an ArgumentNullException.

methods.name: WeCanInjectAConsulClient
methods.description: Tests that a custom IConsulClient can be injected into ConsulClusteringOptions and retrieved correctly.

methods.name: WeCanUseConfigureToSetupTheDefaultClient
methods.description: Verifies that configuring the default client with address and token sets the properties correctly.

methods.name: WeCanUseConfigureToSetupTheDefaultClientWithoutAAclToken
methods.description: Verifies that configuring the default client with only address leaves the token as null.
